  31 func has_asset(asset_id: String) -> bool:
  32 	return BINDINGS.has(asset_id)
  33 
  34 func resolve(asset_id: String) -> Resource:
  35 	if _cache.has(asset_id):
  36 		return _cache[asset_id]
  37 	if not BINDINGS.has(asset_id):
  38 		last_error = "Unknown required asset: " + asset_id
  39 		return null
  40 	var binding: Array = BINDINGS[asset_id]
  41 	if not ResourceLoader.exists(binding[1]):
  42 		last_error = "Missing required asset: " + binding[1]
  43 		return null
  44 	var resource: Resource = load(binding[1])
  45 	if resource == null or not resource.is_class(binding[0]):
  46 		last_error = "Asset type mismatch: %s requires %s" % [asset_id, binding[0]]
  47 		return null
  48 	_cache[asset_id] = resource
  49 	return resource
